description.en: Intended to check whether a given character (by CRC32-hashed ID string) is among the first 5 registered match members (the "main" lineup). Like CMND_BTL_IS_MATCH_MEMBER, the internal lookup result never changes the value pushed back to the script.
Read but not meaningfully used by the check itself.
Character ID string to look up among the first 5 match members.
True on every valid call regardless of whether charaId is actually among the first 5 match members (the internal lookup result is discarded); null if fewer than 2 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Check whether a given character is part of the main lineup for this match
local isMainMember = CMND_BTL_IS_MAIN_MEMBER(0, "para_cp0008");
